preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of vertices in each tree is between 2 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each vertex number is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No vertex is visited more than once.
The first vertex visited is the root.

postconditions.description: Each output is an integer representing the minimum height of a tree with the given visiting order for the i-th test case.
The minimum height of the tree for each test case is at least 1.
The minimum height of the tree for each test case is at most n.
